title: Google Cloud Data Management Products

header.html: 2. Exploring data transformation with Google Cloud (about 18%)

2.2 Determine which Google Cloud data management products are applicable to different business use cases: Cloud Storage, Spanner, Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Bigtable, BigQuery, Firestore; relational, non-relational, object storage, SQL and NoSQL; Cloud Storage classes including Autoclass; migrating and modernizing databases
the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide

html:
1Key concepts

Term Meaning
Relational Data in tables with relationships, queried with SQL
Non-relational (NoSQL) Flexible data models (documents, key-value, wide-column) that scale horizontally
Object storage Files stored as objects with metadata, not in tables
SQL Structured query language for relational data

2Choosing the product

Product What it is Best for
Cloud Storage Object storage, highly durable, unlimited scale Files, images, video, backups, data lakes
Cloud SQL Managed relational database (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) Standard business applications with regional scale
AlloyDB for PostgreSQL PostgreSQL-compatible, high-performance managed database Demanding transactional and analytic workloads that want PostgreSQL
Spanner Globally distributed relational database with strong consistency and horizontal scale Global applications that need relational integrity at huge scale
Bigtable Wide-column NoSQL, very low latency, massive throughput IoT, time series, ad tech, large-scale analytics reads and writes
BigQuery Serverless, managed data warehouse and analytics engine Analytics on huge datasets with SQL, also across clouds
Firestore Serverless document NoSQL database Mobile and web apps, real-time sync
Exam tip

. Files → Cloud Storage. Standard app database → Cloud SQL. Global scale relational → Spanner. Massive low-latency NoSQL → Bigtable. Analytics warehouse → BigQuery. App documents → Firestore.

3BigQuery in a few lines

Point Fact
Serverless No servers to manage; Google handles scale
Managed Storage and compute are separate, so each scales on its own
SQL Analysts use standard SQL
Multicloud BigQuery Omni analyzes data in other clouds without moving it
Built-in AI BigQuery ML builds models with SQL (Module 7)

4Cloud Storage classes

Class Access pattern Typical use
Standard Frequent access Active data, websites, analytics
Nearline About once a month Backups read now and then
Coldline About once a quarter Disaster recovery copies
Archive Less than once a year Long-term archives, compliance
Autoclass Moves objects automatically between classes by how they are accessed When access is unpredictable

Colder classes cost less to store but more to access, and have minimum storage durations.

Exam tip

. Colder = cheaper to keep, costlier to read. Autoclass picks the class for you.

5Migrating and modernizing databases

Option Meaning
Lift and shift Move the database as it is to a managed service or a virtual machine
Move to a managed database For example to Cloud SQL or AlloyDB, so Google runs patching and backups
Modernize Change to a cloud-native database (Spanner, Bigtable, Firestore) for scale and new features
Database Migration Service A managed service that moves databases to Google Cloud with little downtime
Exam tip

. Match the product to the data shape: files = Cloud Storage, tables with joins = Cloud SQL, AlloyDB or Spanner, huge key-value or time series = Bigtable, documents = Firestore, analytics = BigQuery.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A media company needs to store millions of videos and images at any scale. Which product fits best?

  • ACloud SQL for relational tables
  • BCloud Storage for object data
  • CSpanner for global transactions
  • DBigtable for wide-column rows
Show the answer

Answer: B. Cloud Storage is object storage for files such as videos and images.

S2A global payment application needs relational data with strong consistency across several continents. Which product fits?

  • ASpanner, a globally distributed relational database
  • BFirestore for documents in mobile apps
  • CCloud Storage for archive files
  • DBigQuery for warehouse analytics
Show the answer

Answer: A. Spanner is a globally distributed relational database with strong consistency.

S3An IoT company must write millions of sensor readings per second with very low latency. Which product fits best?

  • ACloud SQL, a managed relational database
  • BBigtable, a low-latency wide-column NoSQL database
  • CBigQuery, a serverless data warehouse
  • DCloud Storage, an object store for files
Show the answer

Answer: B. Bigtable gives very low latency and massive throughput for time-series and IoT data.

S4An analytics team wants to run SQL on petabytes of data without managing servers. Which product fits?

  • AAlloyDB for PostgreSQL, a managed database
  • BFirestore, a document database for apps
  • CCloud SQL, a managed database for apps
  • DBigQuery, a serverless data warehouse
Show the answer

Answer: D. BigQuery is a serverless data warehouse for large-scale SQL analytics.

S5A company stores backup data that it reads about once a quarter and wants low storage cost. Which Cloud Storage class fits best?

  • AStandard, for frequently used data
  • BArchive, for data read less than once a year
  • CColdline, for data read about once a quarter
  • DNearline, for data read about once a month
Show the answer

Answer: C. Coldline fits data accessed about once a quarter; Nearline is monthly and Archive is yearly or less.

S6A company's data access is unpredictable and it wants Google Cloud to choose the storage class by itself. Which feature helps?

  • AFirestore, which syncs mobile data
  • BSpanner, which scales relational data
  • CLooker, which builds dashboards
  • DAutoclass, which moves objects between classes
Show the answer

Answer: D. Autoclass moves objects automatically between storage classes based on how they are accessed.

6.2 Recall questions

R1Which product is object storage?

Show the answer

Cloud Storage.

R2Which product is a serverless data warehouse?

Show the answer

BigQuery.

R3Which database is globally distributed and relational?

Show the answer

Spanner.

R4Which database is a wide-column NoSQL for IoT?

Show the answer

Bigtable.

R5What are the four storage classes?

Show the answer

Standard, Nearline, Coldline, Archive.

R6Which service moves databases with little downtime?

Show the answer

Database Migration Service.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Products Cloud Storage (objects), Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Spanner (global), Bigtable (NoSQL scale), BigQuery (warehouse), Firestore (documents)
BigQuery serverless, SQL, Omni for other clouds
Classes Standard, Nearline (monthly), Coldline (quarterly), Archive (yearly), Autoclass
Migration lift and shift, managed database, modernize; Database Migration Service
